content.text: Let me verify the exact ordering directly from the controller source.

Confirmed. Here is the complete, ordered sequence of every validation and side-effect applied when creating an owner via `POST /api/owners`.

The endpoint is handled by `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner` (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:176`), which implements the generated `OwnersApi` interface (class-level `@RequestMapping("/api")` + interface `POST /owners`).

## A. Before the controller body runs (framework-level)

1. **Authorization** — `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")`. Caller must hold the `OWNER_ADMIN` role or the request is denied (`AccessDeniedException`).
2. **Bean Validation of the `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`** — checked *before* any controller code, on the raw (un-normalized) body. Failure → HTTP 400 via `handleMethodArgumentNotValidException`:
   - `firstName`: `@NotNull`, `@Pattern("^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}$")`, `@Size(1..30)`
   - `lastName`: `@NotNull`, `@Pattern("^[\p{L}]+([ '-][\p{L}]+){0,2}\.?$")`, `@Size(1..30)`
   - `address`: `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..255)`
   - `city`: `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..80)`
   - `telephone`: `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..20)`
   - `email`: `@Size(max 255)` (optional/nullable)
   - `postcode`, `registrationDate`, `sharesHousehold`: no declarative constraints

## B. Controller body — validations & normalizations, in exact order

These are imperative private methods (no custom `ConstraintValidator` classes exist). Each runs in the order below:

3. `normalizeAddress` — trims, collapses whitespace, upper-cases, expands `ST→STREET`, `RD→ROAD`, `AVE→AVENUE`. (Mutates the DTO *after* Bean Validation already ran.)
4. `validateRequiredFields` — trims and rejects blank/whitespace-only `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone`; offending fields → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` (400).
5. `normalizeTelephone` — converts to E.164: strips non-digits, assumes `+61` if no country code, drops a leading `0`, requires 8–15 digits, enforces per-country national length (`+1`→10, `+61`→9); invalid → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["telephone"])` (400).
6. `normalizeEmail` — if present, must match the email pattern, then lower-cased; invalid → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["email"])` (400).
7. `validatePostcode` — if present, must be 4 digits and within the region range derived from `city` (`OwnerLocality.derive`); invalid → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["postcode"])` (400).
8. `rejectDuplicateIdentity(..., resolveHouseholdId(...))` — reads all owners; rejects if identity key `telephone|email|householdId` already exists → `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException` (409).
9. `rejectCityAtCapacity` — case-insensitive count of owners in the city; if ≥ 50 → `OwnerCityAtCapacityException` (409).
10. `resolveRegistrationDate` — defaults to `LocalDate.now()` if absent, then rolls a weekend date forward to Monday; **writes the value back into the DTO**.
11. `rejectDailyLimitReached(registrationDate)` — count of owners with the same registration date; if ≥ 100 → `DailyOwnerLimitReachedException` (429).

## C. Mapping & derived-value side-effects (mutating the new Owner), in order

12. `ownerMapper.toOwner(dto)` — MapStruct maps DTO → `Owner` (ignores id, pets, customerCode).
13. `assignCustomerCode` — sets `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` customer code.
14. `assignMembershipNumber` — sets membership number.
15. `assignNamesakeCount` — counts existing owners with the same name.
16. `assignMembershipLevel` — sets membership level.
17. `assignBulkSignupWarning` — sets warning flag (threshold 80).
18. `assignHousehold` — resolves/creates a `householdId` (SHA-256 of `lastName|address`); **may call `saveOwner` on pre-existing owners** to back-fill a shared household id (side-effect on *other* rows).
19. `assignHouseholdMembership` — sets household member count.

## D. Persistence & final side-effects

20. `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` — `@Transactional`; `em.persist` (DB assigns the id). Note `addOwner` itself is **not** transactional, so each read/save is its own transaction.
21. **Audit log** — `AUDIT.info("owner created id=... customerCode=... registrationDate=... membershipLevel=...")` (SLF4J logger named `AUDIT`).
22. `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)` — builds response DTO (derives `displayName`, `initials`, `locality`, `contactPreference`, `identityKey` — response-only).
23. Sets `Location: /api/owners/{id}` header and returns **201 CREATED**.

## Notable absences
- **No** JPA entity lifecycle callbacks (`@PrePersist`/`@PostPersist`/`@EntityListeners`) on `Owner`, `Person`, or `BaseEntity`.
- **No** application events published, and **no** emails sent.
- The `Owner` entity carries its own `@NotEmpty` / `@Pattern("^\+[0-9]{8,15}$")` constraints, but these only fire if the entity is validated on flush — they are not explicitly triggered in this path.

One thing worth flagging: because `normalizeAddress` (step 3) runs *after* Bean Validation (step 2), the `@Size`/`@Pattern` constraints on `address` are checked against the raw input, not the normalized value.
